questions.text: What is the worst-case time complexity of QuickSort when the pivot is always the extreme element?
questions.explanation: When QuickSort partitions on an extreme element each time, recursion depth becomes N resulting in O(N²) time.

questions.text: What is the output of the following Python snippet?
questions.codeSnippet:
x = [1, 2, 3]
y = x
x = x + [4]
print(len(y))
questions.explanation: `x + [4]` creates a new list assigned to `x`, leaving `y` referencing the original 3-element list.
